pages.text: [#](53341a)Eleven chapters lie ahead of this one, pupil, and they open in their proper order — craft a subject's book and its pages appear here.[#]()
pages.title: Path of the Craft

pages.text: [#](53341a)Here is the whole road, so you may see where your feet are headed:[#]()
[#](53341a)**Getting Started** — the altar, the boline, the first roots. **1. Collecting Fumes** — the Witches' Oven and the breaths and odours it renders. **2.[#]()
[#](53341a)Herbology** — Mutandis, the Rowan, the Witch's Cauldron. **3. Brews & Infusions** — the Kettle, and the four paths of infusion. **4.[#]()
[#](53341a)Distilling** — drawing essences out by heat and patience. **5. Circle Magic** — chalk, circles, and the rites of power. **6.[#]()
[#](53341a)Conjuration** — the Brazier, fetishes, and the things you call. **7. Symbology** — the Mystic Branch and glyphs traced in the air. **8.[#]()
[#](53341a)Poppets** — taglocks, poppets, and binding from afar. **9. The Spirit World** — dreams, the dead, and the far country. **10.[#]()
[#](53341a)Creatures** — familiars and the beasts of the craft. **11. Transformations** — the deeper changes: the wolf, the night.[#]()
[#](53341a)The order is a teacher's order, not a cage.[#]()
[#](53341a)Should a coven witch or a dusty bookshop press a later chapter into your hands early, read it gladly — knowledge found is knowledge still.[#]()
